scope: Stage 01 specifies first-consumer boundaries and fixture proofs, without building future scientific schemas or a universal framework.

requirements.title: Independent entry points
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Standalone room/specimen roots are core; direct physical-property choice and independent experimental endpoints remain stages 16/17.

requirements.title: Authoring at any scale
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Core geometry editor exit adopts only ready valid output into captured selected/local scope; later property adoption reuses it at stage 17.

requirements.title: Laboratory as an end goal
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Register independent laboratory endpoints; build structural specimens at stage 12 and actual protocols/results at stage 17.

requirements.title: Quantity is separate from computational population
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Amount metadata and explicit authored/display populations stay separate; no amount-times-Avogadro allocation.

requirements.title: Detail is a spectrum
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Keep source coverage, visual detail, scale, purpose and future numerical fidelity independently selectable.

requirements.title: Shared mechanisms, specialized mathematics
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Use shared identity/change/frame/selection/artifact/demand contracts with domain-specific mathematics.

requirements.title: Cost follows requested work
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Inactive profiles have no active data/worker/body/GPU demand; measure actual requested closure and peaks.

requirements.title: Completion requires intent and evidence
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Advance by working native workflows and observed correctness/quality/resource evidence.

requirements.title: Scene-independent scale, proved early
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: B25 and unrelated B38 use the same generic scale path, with arbitrary data roots/endpoints.

requirements.title: Spatial navigation and local usability
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Select Orbit/Fly/Walk explicitly; preserve supported context and street/interior input.

requirements.title: Sparse demand and durable offline data
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Separate source/offline availability, compressed cache and releasable decoded/GPU residency.

requirements.title: Flat defaults and shared surface sources
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Use constant fallback, imported relief and authored surfaces through shared support/operators; missing geometry stays absent.

requirements.title: One local and hosted workspace model
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Local and hosted content share model/commands/persistence; hosting uses authorized projections.

requirements.title: Participation has an accountable cost
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Show known/unknown costs and enforce continuing device/host/principal admission, including transient peaks.

requirements.title: Access does not propagate through a reference
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: References/invites never lend source login, metadata, execution, pixels, input or spending authority.

requirements.title: Shared state has explicit authority and recovery
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Accepted changes retain designated authority/base/epoch; cached viewing/drafts survive loss without automatic mutation replay.

requirements.title: Stabilization before additional simulation
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Stabilize the complete core at stage 15 before new physical-material/scientific work.

requirements.title: Admission, ownership and overload
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Admit bytes/queues/scratch/replacement before dispatch; bounded saturation preserves accepted sources and laws.

requirements.title: Ordered acceptance with parallel evaluation
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Accept actor/scope/base/request identity coherently, persist receipts and reject stale or revoked completion.

requirements.title: Compile semantics into numerical work
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Compile demanded typed inputs to compact numerical buffers only when a selected operation needs them.

requirements.title: Coherent projections and subscriptions
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Initialize coherent authorized projections and apply atomic deltas; gaps reset within bounds and revocation invalidates scope.

requirements.title: Independent clocks, cadence and numerical fidelity
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Register independent physical-clock/fidelity requirements; no new scientific clock/domain during core delivery.

requirements.title: Data movement, persistence and devices
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Separate persisted source, decoded/staged/runtime data and retained results; validate bounded transfer and completion.

requirements.title: Controlled failures and reproducibility
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Capture reproducible real acceptance/storage/job/transport failure schedules; distinguish control replay from numerical reproducibility.

requirements.title: Whole-application cost and capability growth
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Budget the whole app across native input, views, jobs and serving; prove one-lane progress and mixed-workload fairness.

requirements.title: Workspace identity, hosting and invitations
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Reuse workspace identity, publishing/invitation/policy and explicit hosting configuration.

requirements.title: Disconnect, offline use, reconnection and host recovery
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Retain permitted cached state/drafts, resolve recorded request outcomes and revalidate current grants before explicit reconciliation.

requirements.title: Principals, scoped access and public visiting
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Represent restricted guest separately from trusted-local None; intersect participant, source and field/payload rights.

requirements.title: Entry manifest, cost estimate and resource reservation
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Serve bounded permitted entry metadata and finite/unknown costs before detailed transfer; reserve continuing limits.

requirements.title: Entry, materialization and native states
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Expose ready/adjusted/partial/refused/materializing states in native UI through the same sparse loader.

requirements.title: Sparse subscriptions and independent delivery policies
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Separate reliable accepted deltas/receipts from replaceable presence and revocable bounded asset streams.

requirements.title: Collaborative tools, presence and shared behavior
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Reuse captured scope/conflicts/undo/drafts; camera/presence is not physical or accepted mutation authority.

requirements.title: Shared runs and execution authority
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Register future observe/interact/start/cancel/spending separation and fenced writer; numerical proof begins at stage 17.

requirements.title: Protein, other Organs and external dependencies
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Keep each Organ's independent Protein login/session/query lifetime; unavailable optional content stays localized.

requirements.title: Content validation, execution and application surfaces
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Validate bounded content and capability requirements; import never installs code or grants desktop/input/execution.

requirements.title: View and binding
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Views bind to the same accepted subjects with independent camera/focus/clock state and declared frames.

requirements.title: Presentation and surface composition
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Spatial/flat/HUD and supported app surfaces reuse source, focus and input ownership; each presentation owns bounded demand.

requirements.title: Selection, query and region
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: One permission-aware selection/region query serves scene/tree/numeric/Agent tools; target and region are independent.

requirements.title: Tool and transaction
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Native and Agent tools share preview/validate/commit/cancel/undo and explicit captured edit scope.

requirements.title: Anchor, attachment and registration
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Mounts/registration retain source selection, frame/local coordinates, follow policy and last usable pose.

requirements.title: Demand and activity
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Aggregate demand across views/jobs/participants; last release cancels and frees only that consumer's dependencies.

requirements.title: Identity, definitions, occurrences and revisions
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Reuse existing UID validation, immutable definition revisions, stable slots/occurrences and optional Record bindings; keep graphs distinct.

requirements.title: Frames, precision, units and clocks
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Use declared units and relative local frames; stage 03 selects big_space or a bounded replacement from two-view evidence.

requirements.title: Spatial support, topology, selections and correspondence
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Selection/support queries report source revision and exact/approximate/unsupported status; failed correspondence needs repair.

requirements.title: Quantities, fields, evidence and unknown values
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Use exact authored/accounting values where required, finite typed numerical buffers and explicit unknown/evidence status.

requirements.title: Relations, ports and constraints
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Keep containment, attachment, ownership, custody, constraints and future physical laws distinct relation kinds.

requirements.title: Operators, derivations and incremental evaluation
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Use captured-input derivations, exact keys, changed-only invalidation and bounded generation-checked jobs.

requirements.title: Representations, quality and scale transitions
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Preserve source with purpose-specific render/pick/support/etc. products; camera detail cannot change accepted facts or future physics.

requirements.title: Domains, state, observations and scenarios
requirements.core_application_or_deferred_boundary: Keep source versus evolving state distinct now; new physical domains/clocks/writers are implemented at stage 18.

ownership.pure_model: A small pure workspace_model module/crate may use pure nucleus types when stage 02 needs it; nucleus must not import workspace_model or UI.
ownership.acceptance_and_persistence: Existing engine/store/workspace authority and accepted operation paths.
ownership.native_interaction: Existing interface/native controls, canvas host, views and operation bindings.
ownership.geographic_context: Map/provider adapters supply CRS/layers; no required Earth root in generic frames/loader.
ownership.delivery: Existing transport/Cell/Organ source authorization with bounded scoped extensions.
ownership.specialist_work: Selected geometry/numerical adapters consume captured inputs and return products; they never own accepted heads or UI.
ownership.stage_01_tooling: crates/xtask/src/workspace prepares/checks fixture data; its schema and labels are not production model APIs.

logical_ids.choice: Opaque validated strings through existing nucleus UID conventions, with distinct Rust types for document/definition/slot/occurrence/selection/product at their first consumer.
logical_ids.stable_occurrence: root occurrence identity plus stable slot path, captured with composition revision.
logical_ids.dense_elements: Compact typed local element/site IDs and explicit source mappings, not a Record/ECS object per element.
logical_ids.actors: Existing Person/Agent Record identity and delegated scope; no duplicate Actor enum required.

canonical_revision.choice: Reuse nucleus karma::CanonicalHash/canonical JSON conventions after typed workspace schema/domain tagging.
canonical_revision.observed_current_encoding: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits; canonical JSON domain lince.canonical-json.v1.
canonical_revision.current_constraint: Existing canonical JSON rejects floating-point JSON numbers; accepted authored/numerical inputs must use exact scalar atoms or typed payload references.
canonical_revision.raw_payload_digest: Typed raw-file SHA-256 digest over bytes, separate from domain-tagged canonical JSON identity even though both use SHA-256.
canonical_revision.mutable_heads: An authorized head/envelope references immutable content; hashes do not replace logical identity.

scalars.normalization: Use existing exact decimal parsing/canonicalization for accepted values; retain original UI text separately when useful.
scalars.approximate_numerical: Finite f32/f64 buffers with explicit component/kind/unit/frame/error and little-endian encoding; optional scalar f64 bit pattern is a fixed-width hex string in canonical descriptors.
scalars.guard: No universal world-grid/cache rounding, NaN sentinel or conversion of exact operational balances through GPU floats.

cell_and_residual_candidate.cell_index: signed i128 serialized as decimal text
cell_and_residual_candidate.cell_size: positive per-frame exact length, not a fixed world constant
cell_and_residual_candidate.residual: bounded local authored exact scalar or declared finite numerical value

frames.selection_point: Stage 03's pinned big_space/two-distant-view spike selects runtime storage and range/error; the durable contract preserves local source precision.
frames.fixture_boundary: The stage01 fixture JSON uses explicit relative metre-valued f64 data for inspection; it is not the accepted canonical workspace encoding.
required_proofs: distinct authored values below 1 nm retain distinct source/derivation identities

binary_payloads.validation: Checked count/offset/stride multiplication before allocation; bounded decode; finite geometry; error/unsupported status and rights.
binary_payloads.first_payload: Supported retained mesh source/render data; solver and microscopic dense schemas appear only at their owning stage.

manifest.numeric_values: Exact scalar atoms or typed binary references, suitable for existing canonical hashing.

descriptor_pages.scope: Bounded immutable definitions/slots/selection/derivation descriptors; root does not enumerate a world.

directory_minimum.payloads: payloads/<raw-file-digest>.<declared-format>; original sources and license/provenance are retained within authorized closure.
directory_minimum.head_publication: Workspace envelope or local HEAD outside the content being hashed. Prepare/check durable chunks and manifest before atomic accepted-root publication; recover previous valid root after interruption.
outside_portable_snapshot: local draft journal unless explicitly selected
directory_minimum.reuse: Existing local workspace assets and engine/store references; packing is optional and the interoperable selected container is delivered at stage 06.

native_and_agent_edit_flow.first_case: Create two occurrences of one furnishing/part, select one, edit local placement, undo/save/reopen, import required definitions and compare outcomes.
native_and_agent_edit_flow.scope_default: Captured selected occurrence or normal captured multi-selection; shared definition updates are explicit.
minimum_command: executing Actor and delegator if any
native_and_agent_edit_flow.acceptance: Same native/programmatic validation and current authority intersection, short coherent durable commit, created/changed IDs and recorded receipt.
native_and_agent_edit_flow.long_work: Capture immutable inputs and admission, release transaction/input loop, publish only if generation/base/scope/rights remain valid.
native_and_agent_edit_flow.editor_exit: Automatically apply ready valid applicable output to captured scope; pending/invalid/cancelled/stale output preserves previous accepted result and draft.
native_and_agent_edit_flow.import: Include required permitted definitions; verify source/revision/typed equality, preserve conflicts and provenance, bind inherited environment once at destination, never install code.
native_and_agent_edit_flow.presentation: One source/Record identity across spatial/flat/HUD, with separate focus/layout/camera/anchor demand.
native_and_agent_edit_flow.fiote: Use existing Agent/delegation/provider tools; no model call inside edit transaction, startup or per-frame control. Provider loss leaves native use complete.
native_and_agent_edit_flow.linked_work: Stage 11 emits revisioned selected takeoff; stage 13 refreshes unaccepted derived fields while preserving manual overrides and reconciling accepted commitments.

first_adapter_record.selected_library: Existing xtask gltf =1.4.1, glam =0.33.7 and image =0.25.10
first_adapter_record.units: glTF metre/Y-up with explicit source-to-frame mapping where needed
first_adapter_record.identity: Fixture source labels and verified file bytes, not production accepted model IDs
first_adapter_record.source_preservation: Original full Fiote source stays intact; derived starter repacks two clips and retains source/credits.
first_adapter_record.bounds_and_recovery: Fixture profile caps, local bounded reads, failed output has no verified manifest; existing output directory is never replaced.

targets.stage01_verified_target: Linux x86_64, exact run/build evidence retained separately
targets.other_targets: Not certified by this Stage 01 run; future product adapters record their own platform proof.

reproducibility.prepared_bytes: Two fresh preparations must match byte for byte on the recorded source/build; fixture tests compare every output.
reproducibility.geometry_tolerance: Finite fixture transforms and normalized skin weights; waypoint precision targets do not certify future runtime precision.
reproducibility.identity: Raw SHA-256 binds exact asset bytes; existing typed canonical revisions bind accepted model sources separately.

cancellation.preparation: Synchronous bounded offline fixture command; no remote request or scientific worker. Failure does not replace an existing directory. Partial new outputs are unverified.
cancellation.inspection: Bounded individual/aggregate reads and tree/count caps; CLI can be interrupted. No production decoder termination guarantee is inferred.

first_adapter_record.failure_recovery: No accepted production state is mutated. Existing outputs are refused before writing; prepare/check failures retain source assets and return an error. Missing manifest or failed check cannot be used as fixture verification.
first_adapter_record.conformance_evidence: dataset-inspection.json and command/test evidence are produced after actual preparation/check; runtime milestones remain at phase owners.

alternatives_not_selected: A single mesh/voxel/JSON object type for every domain: retain domain payloads behind shared identities/operations instead.
A database, permission or global scheduler rewrite: extend existing acceptance/session/demand ownership only where the next real slice needs it.
Using camera zoom or geographic names as scale transitions: B25 and unrelated B38 must use the same implementation.
Persisting render entities or rounding source values for cache keys: preserve stable source identity and exact captured inputs.
Canonicalizing arbitrary f64 JSON directly: the current canonical helper requires exact atoms/typed payload references.
A complete new file-format/kernel/framework implementation in stage 01: freeze this minimum and implement it through the tiny native stage 02 case.

remaining_decisions.question: Pinned big_space fit and runtime cell/residual storage
remaining_decisions.decisive_evidence: Two distant close-up views, moving/origin-shifted frames, exact local source preservation.

remaining_decisions.question: Globe/refinement/depth/controller implementation and real provider subset
remaining_decisions.decisive_evidence: B25/B38 inward/outward route, horizon/interior use and starter peaks/release.

remaining_decisions.question: Packed container codec/paging and a real saved city
remaining_decisions.decisive_evidence: Authorized closure/resume/packed-directory equivalence and bounded offline route.

remaining_decisions.question: Exact CAD adapter
remaining_decisions.decisive_evidence: Existing prescribed bake-off including shape/history, failures, licensing/packaging and whole-path cost.

remaining_decisions.question: Reviewed human anatomical reference sources and coverage
remaining_decisions.decisive_evidence: Actual prepared pack counts/rights, named upper-limb mapping, useful pose checks and admitted cost.

remaining_decisions.question: Material knowledge sources and applicable property models
remaining_decisions.decisive_evidence: Direct material choice, provenance/conditions/units/conflict/unknown checks; no stage01 dataset selection.

remaining_decisions.question: Numerical studies, parameters, workers and tolerances
remaining_decisions.decisive_evidence: Authorized named study with independent references, actual sample/replica/output budgets and applicable model.
